main.description: Register a draft red team scope contract for an owner-attested target set. Status starts as 'draft' and requires approveScope before runProbe will be authorized.

scopeId.description: Caller-chosen identifier (rkey) for this scope contract.

ownerDid.description: DID of the target owner attesting the scope (did:web | did:plc | did:gftd).

targets.description: Explicit IPs, CIDRs, hostnames, or URLs. No wildcards beyond CIDR.

excludedTargets.description: Targets that MUST be skipped even if covered by a CIDR in targets.

allowedPorts.description: Explicit ports. Empty = no port-bound probing allowed.

allowedPaths.description: For url kind, explicit path prefixes.

validUntilMs.description: Engagement window end (epoch ms). Default cap = validFromMs + 14d.

rateLimitRps.description: Max requests per second per target. Default = 1.

legalBasis.description: Reference to SOW id, contract clause, CTF rules, bug bounty URL, or written authorization document CID.
